_note: uv sync --extra crafter (crafter-gym, gym/crafter/, pulls crafter), then pip install --force-reinstall 'crafter @ git+https://github.com/chengfanbrain/crafter.git@deterministic' -- a fork of 1.8.3 whose single change is that a seed plus an action list replays exactly (see _state_note). Plain PyPI crafter runs this config fine and plays identically to a subject, but its blocks cannot be replayed, so a model cannot be given the same episode. This is the paradigm's level 4 (survival): hostiles on, health/food/drink/energy decay, death ends the episode, nothing hidden from the HUD. It is stock crafter, rule for rule: what is written down below is the interface it is played through and the pacing, not the game. Levels 1-3 freeze or remove parts of the game and belong in a gymnasium.Wrapper shipped with the env, as the menu is (gym/crafter/crafter_gym/menu.py): a level an adapter applied would stop humans and models from playing the same game.
_level_note: Level 2 of the paradigm's four (crafter_gym.levels.LEVELS, the rig's own table): the homeostat runs and is shown, nothing hostile. The task chain names one of fifteen entries at a time (crafter_gym.tasks), drink / eat / sleep among them once a stat first drops to 8 of 9.
_shared_note: Every other field of the game phase is level 4's, and so are the notes that explain them: see configs/dbp_games/crafter__crafter_L4.json.

instructions.title: Crafter, level 2
text: Explore the world and try things.
The game itself will show you what works.
Pay attention to your health.
The world waits for you: it moves one step each
time you press a button, and not otherwise.
One task at a time is named above the game. Reach
it and the game says so, and names the next one.
Controls (8 buttons):
ARROWS      move
D           interact / attack / collect
S           sleep
W           next menu item
A           do the menu item
The menu holds the ten actions with no button of
their own: place stone, table, furnace, plant, and
make a wood / stone / iron pickaxe or sword. Last
in it is skip task, which puts your current task
off until later. W moves the cursor and shows it
over your character; A performs it. Moving the
cursor also costs a turn.
(press SPACE to start)
